title: The Clue of the Twisted Candle
description: A mystery involving the murder of Remington Kara, a wealthy Greek with a dark past, and the intricate web of clues leading to the truth behind his death. The story explores themes of revenge, deception, and the complexities of criminal investigation.
intro_narrative: John Lexman, a renowned mystery writer, finds himself entangled in a deadly plot after borrowing money from the sinister moneylender Vassalaro, introduced to him by Remington Kara. When Vassalaro is found murdered, Lexman becomes the prime suspect. His wife, Grace, disappears under mysterious circumstances, and Lexman is convicted and imprisoned. Years later, Lexman escapes from Dartmoor Prison with the help of Kara, only to discover Kara's true malevolent nature. The narrative unfolds as Lexman seeks revenge and uncovers the dark secrets surrounding Kara's death.

required_evidence: Twisted candle found in Kara's room
Letter written on chemically treated paper (burnt)
Telephone call from Kara's room during murder
Artificial arm (Gathercole's right arm, not left)
Candle chips and grease traces in Kara's room
Dog killed in cellar (evidence of struggle)
required_motive: Revenge for the death of Grace Lexman
Kara's history of cruelty and manipulation
Kara's involvement in blackmail and murder
